agent_base_units.command:
cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
path='call.go'
s=open(path).read()
old='''	v.sp = 1 + numArgs
	for i := 0; i < numArgs; i++ {
		v.stack[1+i] = args[i]
	}
'''
new='''	v.sp = 1 + fn.NumLocals
	for i := 0; i < numArgs; i++ {
		v.stack[1+i] = args[i]
	}
'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(path,'w').write(s)
print("patched")
PY
cd /app && go test ./... 2>&1 | tail -12
